The '''T-238 grenade''' was a model of [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenade]].<ref name="MB1st" /> It was filled with the chemical [[Agent T-238]], which attacked an individual's digestive tract and induced nausea in its victims for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> T-238 grenades were commonly deployed for crowd control or riot suppression operations.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
